versions.changelog:
- Added step-by-step process for generating Vibe-style, narration-free vertical videos from user topics.
- Clarified environment setup, music configuration steps, and required dependencies.
- Defined video output specs: 60s, 9:16, 2K (1440×2560), 30fps, MP4, no voiceover.
- Outlined strict workflow: fact-checking, storyboard, music sync, animation, visual preview, and technical validation before delivery.
- Emphasized use of custom animation/code per topic, not just text swaps or reusing old assets.
- Specified deliverables: only fully rendered videos meet completion; text/storyboards/animation alone don’t count unless requested.
